name: rt_sheet_chimneys
subject: this is a sprite sheet. Each grey box becomes exactly one game sprite, painted to fill its own box edge to edge (its outer edge on the box's edge, nothing outside its box, nothing touching another box); the grey of the box is fully replaced. The magenta background stays one flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere outside the boxes: no shadows, no ground, no sky, no glow, no outline on it. BOX A (the box at top left, top-left corner at game pixel (6, 6), exactly 104 x 96 game pixels): wide chimney stack in the drying yard (the dog climbs loose tiles up to it and stands on its top); the dog stands on it or bumps into it. Look: a sandstone slab cap 7 px tall on top, 1 px wider than the body on each side: top row lit #CCAE8B, middle #A28B75, bottom row #7F685F, under it a 2 px dark shadow band #4F4039 across the body; stucco body in the hotel chimney's colours: body #8D6D5A, a lit band 3 to 4 px wide down the left edge #C19674, a shaded band 3 to 4 px wide down the right edge #624742, the right edge itself #4F4039; like the hotel chimney: 6 to 10 short dark horizontal dashes (3 to 6 px long, #624742) scattered as worn brick joints, and one small darker damp blotch near the bottom; no texture noise; the top is flat and clear (no pots, the dog stands there); an unbroken 1 px dark outline #2D2224 all round. BOX B (the box at top middle, top-left corner at game pixel (118, 6), exactly 64 x 96 game pixels): the chimney sweep's chimney block on the market hall roof (part of the roof; three pots, piece F, stand on top); part of the roof the dog walks on. Look: a sandstone slab cap 6 px tall on top, 1 px wider than the body on each side: top row lit #CCAE8B, middle #A28B75, bottom row #7F685F, under it a 2 px dark shadow band #4F4039 across the body; stucco body in the hotel chimney's colours: body #8D6D5A, a lit band 3 to 4 px wide down the left edge #C19674, a shaded band 3 to 4 px wide down the right edge #624742, the right edge itself #4F4039; on the right side, half way down, one patch where the stucco has broken off showing 4 to 6 courses of red brick (#AB503A bricks, #78352D joints) with a ragged stucco edge, as in the market painting; a 3 px soot-darkened band under the slab (#624742); 1 px dark outline #2D2224 all round. BOX C (the box at top right, top-left corner at game pixel (190, 6), exactly 64 x 96 game pixels): the hotel chimney block on the hotel roof (part of the roof; three pots, piece G, stand on top); part of the roof the dog walks on. Look: a sandstone slab cap 6 px tall on top, 1 px wider than the body on each side: top row lit #CCAE8B, middle #A28B75, bottom row #7F685F, under it a 2 px dark shadow band #4F4039 across the body; stucco body in the hotel chimney's colours: body #8D6D5A, a lit band 3 to 4 px wide down the left edge #C19674, a shaded band 3 to 4 px wide down the right edge #624742, the right edge itself #4F4039; like the hotel chimney: 6 to 10 short dark horizontal dashes (3 to 6 px long, #624742) scattered as worn brick joints, and one small darker damp blotch near the bottom; no texture noise; 1 px dark outline #2D2224 all round. BOX D (the box at top right, top-left corner at game pixel (262, 6), exactly 32 x 96 game pixels): the nest chimney: the tallest, slimmest chimney of the old town; the gull nest (piece H) sits on its slab; part of the roof the dog walks on. Look: a sandstone slab cap 5 px tall on top, 1 px wider than the body on each side: top row lit #CCAE8B, middle #A28B75, bottom row #7F685F, under it a 2 px dark shadow band #4F4039 across the body; stucco body in the hotel chimney's colours: body #8D6D5A, a lit band 3 to 4 px wide down the left edge #C19674, a shaded band 3 to 4 px wide down the right edge #624742, the right edge itself #4F4039 (bands 2 px wide); 3 or 4 short dark joint dashes; 1 px dark outline #2D2224 all round. BOX E (the box at bottom left, top-left corner at game pixel (6, 110), exactly 104 x 88 game pixels): the chimney stacks on the stacks roof (T6): a wide stack the dog stands on; the dog stands on it or bumps into it. Look: a sandstone slab cap 7 px tall on top, 1 px wider than the body on each side: top row lit #CCAE8B, middle #A28B75, bottom row #7F685F, under it a 2 px dark shadow band #4F4039 across the body; stucco body in the hotel chimney's colours: body #8D6D5A, a lit band 3 to 4 px wide down the left edge #C19674, a shaded band 3 to 4 px wide down the right edge #624742, the right edge itself #4F4039; like the hotel chimney: 6 to 10 short dark horizontal dashes (3 to 6 px long, #624742) scattered as worn brick joints, and one small darker damp blotch near the bottom; no texture noise; a 4 px soot-darkened band under the slab; the top flat and clear; an unbroken 1 px dark outline #2D2224 all round. BOX F (the box at bottom middle, top-left corner at game pixel (118, 110), exactly 64 x 24 game pixels): the sweep's chimney pots: decoration standing on top of block B; decoration only. Look: three upright terracotta chimney pots on a 4 px brick footing the full width (#AB503A bricks, #78352D joints): heights 16, 20 and 16 px plus footing, evenly spaced, each with a rolled lip 1 px wider each side and a dark opening #46201B, clay #DF7B4D lit left, #AB503A body, #78352D shaded right; no outline, the edges a darker shade of their own clay. BOX G (the box at bottom right, top-left corner at game pixel (190, 110), exactly 64 x 24 game pixels): the hotel chimney pots: decoration standing on top of block C; decoration only. Look: exactly the hotel painting's three pots: the middle one tallest (about 22 px), the outer two about 17 px, rolled lips, dark openings, clay #DF7B4D / #AB503A / #78352D / #46201B, standing on a 2 px sandstone strip; no outline. BOX H (the box at top right, top-left corner at game pixel (262, 110), exactly 40 x 10 game pixels): the gull nest on the nest chimney: decoration; decoration only. Look: a shallow bowl of crossed twigs and straw seen from the front, a few twig ends sticking out past the bowl, browns #9A7251 #75523E #623E2C and straw #CCAE8B; empty (the ball is a game sprite); no outline. BOX I (the box at bottom middle, top-left corner at game pixel (118, 142), exactly 24 x 48 game pixels): one tall clay chimney pot the dog can stand on; the dog stands on it or bumps into it. Look: an upright terracotta pot, straight sides, a rolled lip on top 2 px wider each side with a flat top edge, a 3 px base ring; clay #DF7B4D lit band left, #AB503A body, #78352D shaded right, #46201B darkest; an unbroken 1 px dark outline #2D2224 all round. The black dog stays exactly as it is; it only shows the size of one game pixel
extra: The other images are the approved concept paintings of this level: copy their materials, colours, outlines, pixel size and level of detail exactly; take from them only how each object looks, not their scenes. VIEW: a strict flat front elevation, like an architect's front drawing: the viewer looks straight at the front face of every object; no top surfaces, no side faces, no 3/4 view, no perspective, no vanishing points, no tilted or converging lines; every horizontal edge exactly horizontal, every vertical edge exactly vertical; round things show as flat-fronted upright shapes whose roundness is only flat shade bands. Light from the upper left; depth only by flat shade bands (lit left edge, shaded right edge, a darker band under every overhang). PIXEL GRID: Image 1 is a 320 x 240 game frame shown at 4x; the result is reduced back to that size and every box is cut out by its rectangle, so draw exactly on Image 1's pixel grid: every pixel square, the size of the dog's pixels, aligned to the same grid; one flat colour per pixel; no anti-aliasing, no in-between edge colours, no dithering, no texture noise, no lone specks; straight lines exactly straight; nothing smudged or painterly. The light described above only shades the inside of each sprite: no sky, clouds or cast shadows are drawn; the magenta stays untouched. No text, no labels, no letters, no numbers, no logos anywhere.
